standard_prerequisites.name: Robust Sylvester-Gallai theorem and standard algebraic tools
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Original CCC Section2 definitions/statements retained, including robust theorem13[9], resultant17[8], Nullstellensatz and UFD usage; no recursive proof of external standard results.

standard_prerequisites.name: Small product-in-radical witness bound
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: CCC Claim35 and journal Claim3.2 cite original Gupta Claim11, with author statement retained.

core_obligations: Preserve complex field, homogeneous quadratic/irreducible-or-square and pairwise independence assumptions, and exact vanishing-product condition.
Keep complete CCC main proof, including both rank regimes and all dependent claims, without replacing them by later journal Section5.
Supply the full published author structural-classification proof for exact CCC Theorem5 using journal3.1 with per-span version and licensing.
Group the dimension bound and its structural tools once; do not claim a general PIT algorithm.
difficulty_reason: The author combines a resultant classification of two-quadratic radical ideals with robust incidence geometry and projection maps; the main proof handles global pair distributions and high/low-rank product-dominated configurations. These are explicit nonroutine algebraic/geometric mechanisms.
